## Package manager

## From 0.23

| 0.23 | 1.0 |
| ---- | --- |
| [`btn`](https://github.com/chrissgon/perfectui/blob/v0.23.0/docs/button.md) | `pui-btn pui-solid pui-theme` |
| `chip` | `pui-chip` |

| A wide table | with | many | long | columns | that | cannot | fit | on | a | phone |
| ------------ | ---- | ---- | ---- | ------- | ---- | ------ | --- | -- | - | ----- |
| `pui-btn pui-solid pui-theme` | `pui-btn pui-soft pui-success` | `pui-btn pui-outline pui-error` | `pui-btn pui-link pui-warn` | `pui-chip pui-solid pui-muted` | `pui-badge pui-soft pui-surface` | `pui-card` | `pui-table` | `pui-list` | `pui-modal` | `pui-tooltip` |

## A diff

```diff
- <button class="btn style-solid-primary">Save</button>
+ <button class="pui-btn pui-solid pui-theme">Save</button>
  <p>unchanged</p>
```
